query: What evaluation metrics and per-language validation plan (precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices) will validate classifiers for explicit and implicit ethics categories?

response.query: What evaluation metrics and per-language validation plan (precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices) will validate classifiers for explicit and implicit ethics categories?
response.answer: For classifier validation, use precision, recall, and F1 score. Confusion matrices will help evaluate true positives, false positives, true negatives, and false negatives for explicit and implicit ethics categories.
